test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: It takes 15 seconds for a 375-m long train to pass a pole. How long will it take to pass a 975-m long platform?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = 375 m

Time to pass a pole = 15 seconds

Length of the platform = 975 m

**Formula Used:**

Speed of the train = Distance / Time

Time to pass a platform = (Length of the train + Length of the platform) / Speed of the train

**Calculation:**

Speed of the train = 375 m / 15 s

Speed of the train = 25 m/s

Time to pass a platform = (375 m + 975 m) / 25 m/s

⇒ Time to pass a platform = 1350 m / 25 m/s

⇒ Time to pass a platform = 54 seconds

**The time it takes to pass a 975-m long platform is 54 seconds.**
